description: This file defines data structures and a registry for displaying tool details, including configuration loading, resolving tool summaries, and helper functions for string and data processing.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A struct representing a summarized display of a tool, including its name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail, with computed properties for formatted lines.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: A singleton enum managing the configuration and resolution of tool display summaries based on a JSON config file.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a ToolDisplaySummary based on the tool's name, arguments, and optional metadata, applying configuration and fallbacks.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the configuration from a JSON resource file, or returns a default configuration on failure.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Provides a default ToolDisplayConfig object with predefined tools and settings.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Converts a raw name string into a nicely formatted title string.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a string to form a user-friendly verb for display.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Generates a detail string for 'read' actions based on the path and optional offset/limit.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Retrieves the 'path' detail from the arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Returns the first non-nil rendered value from a list of keys in the arguments.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Converts a given value into a string preview for display.

methods.name: valueForKeyPath
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from arguments based on a dot-separated key path.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces the home directory path with '~' in a string.
